act_title: The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board Act, 2006
title: Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate proceedings of the Board
text:
9. Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate proceedings of the Board.—No act or proceeding of the Board

shall be invalid merely by reason of—

(a) any vacancy in, or any defect in the constitution of, the Board; or

(b) any defect in the appointment of a person acting as a member of the Board; or

(c) any irregularity in the procedure of the Board not affecting the merits of the case.
